claim: PAEP/glycodelin is a secretory-phase product, mainly glandular
local_pdf: context/literature/pdfs/Stavreus-Evers et al. - 2006 - Glycodelin is present in pinopodes of receptive-phase human endometrium and is associated with down-.pdf
system_from_methods: human endometrial biopsies, 25 proven-fertile women, LH-timed; IHC and immuno-TEM
checked: Fig 1a-d (glandular staining at LH+9/10, absent at LH+6, stroma unstained); Fig 1g-h (gold particles on luminal apical surface/pinopodes at LH+8)
supports: E_PAEP as a secretory readout; not luminal-specific
does_not_support: a causal role in attachment (descriptive only); "not luminal" (protein is present on the luminal apical surface)

claim: Progestin-induced HAND2 suppresses stromal FGF9 in human endometrial stromal cells
